title: the Sundered Sea Rising Anew
premise: Odile Villalobos, an exiled storm-caller hiding in the valley where magic cannot follow, learns the crown has begun hunting anyone with the gift — and that the valley's protection is failing. Guided by a deserter who once helped exile them, Odile must cross a country whose borders have been magically erased from every map, seeking the Sundered Sea, the only door out. Along the way they must choose between exposing the deserter's role in their family's ruin or trusting him to survive the crossing. In the end, Odile calls one last storm over the vanished coast, tearing open the sea-door at terrible cost to their own memory of home — and steps through into a world that will never know what was sacrificed.
about_author: Xanthe Villalobos is the pen name of a former cartographer who spent years mapping coastlines that no longer appear on modern charts. They write fantasy about erased places and the people stubborn enough to remember them.

chapters.title: The Valley That Forgets
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. Years of quiet exile in the magic-dead valley shatter when a wounded stranger, the deserter Cassian, arrives with news of the crown's purge — and proof that the valley's dampening field is fraying. When hunters burn the valley's edge village, Odile's suppressed gift stirs for the first time in a decade. Emotional beat: dread giving way to the terrifying relief of feeling the storm again.

chapters.title: A Country Off the Map
chapters.summary: Alternating POV between Odile and Cassian. Fleeing through farmland that official maps no longer acknowledge, they discover whole towns erased from record, their inhabitants hunted or forgotten. Odile learns Cassian was the officer who signed their family's exile order. Emotional beat: loyalty tested against truth as Odile conceals what they know, needing him alive to navigate the unmade roads.

chapters.title: What the Tide Remembers
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. At the drowned ruins of the old capital, the erased country's memories pool like water, and Odile relives their family's ruin — learning Cassian falsified the order to save them, not condemn them. Hunters close in; Cassian is captured buying time at the seawall. Emotional beat: grief transmuted into fury, and the choice to fight rather than flee alone.

chapters.title: The Door Out of Nowhere
chapters.summary: Odile's POV, climax and resolution. Calling a storm with no name left to lose, Odile tears open the Sundered Sea's hidden door while rescuing Cassian from the pyre. The price: the valley, their mother's voice, every memory of home burns away in the working. They step onto foreign sand together, strangers to their own past but not to each other. Emotional beat: sorrow braided with hard-won hope.
